Operation Checks ✅ Before Takeoff Calibrate the IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit) and compass.
Ensure the GPS lock is strong (minimum 7 satellites).
Test basic controls (throttle, yaw, pitch, roll) before liftoff.
Announce takeoff and check surroundings for safety
hazards.
✅ During Flight Monitor battery levels and signal strength.
Keep the drone within the visual line of sight (VLOS).
Follow all DGCA altitude and distance restrictions.
Maintain situational awareness and be ready to abort if
needed.
✅ Landing & Post-Flight Checklist Land in a safe, designated area.
Power down the drone and disconnect the battery.
Inspect for any damage or unusual heating.
Log flight details in your operation record book. 42
